summary: Optional Slack notifications fire when posts are submitted for review or published, without blocking editorial flows.
detailed_changes: Added SlackEditorialNotifier using SLACK_BOT_USER_OAUTH_TOKEN and default channel from config/services.php.
Notify on staff submit-for-review and publish (UI and Admin API publish path).
Missing Slack config is a no-op; failures are logged only.
affected_areas: Page or route: staff post publish/review; Slack workspace channel
Internal impact: optional Slack alerts gated by env secrets
